title: Converting back to billable starts from the customer's saved default
custom_preconds:
BLOCKED ON RELEASE: this test checks Bill To on internal and No Charge work orders, which needs Internal Work Orders (SV-11665), not released yet. Do not run it now. It can be tested once SV-11665 is released.

Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, customer A's payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, picked by hand as the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer C, where customer C was picked on the Customer card.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Convert work order 1 to No Charge.
  3. Convert work order 1 back to billable.
  4. Expand the Customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1 is No Charge.

Step 3:

  • Work order 1 is billable again.

Step 4:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.
